notes.title: Another Mind Exploding Update!
notes.content:
The lighting system has been completely rebuilt! It was an insane thing to do, a bit like replacing the ground floor of a skyscraper, but we did it anyway. Why? you ask. Well, the old lighting system couldn't handle some edge cases very well, and the new system is faster, looks better, and light sources can now have different colours!

You can now craft potions!

Lots of other small improvements as well.

Keep that hearth burning!

notes.title: Another Triumph!
notes.content:
Yes folks, it's another mind blowing update!

You can now hold shift to auto-select some actions.

A couple of new items, some balancing, lots of bug squashing and more!

notes.title: Quick Bug Patch
notes.content: Just a fix for a few bugs introduced in the last update :)

notes.title: Another Exciting Update!
notes.content:
New Housing window, so that you can see which species might be attracted by a given room. (Note: you must have enough rooms for all of your existing characters before you will start to attract new ones. This will be made apparent in game following a later update).

Some new items, including a number of trap items, and a new creature (Jelly).

Characters in the starting group can now be individually randomised.

notes.title: Values Tweaked!
notes.content: Some values changed, more bugs fixed and the introduction of a few more character traits.

notes.title: More Stuff!
notes.content: Map groups improved, NPC's no longer wander off to die in the snow (may still happen sometimes), various other bugs fixed, rules changed and values tweaked.

notes.title: Small Update!
notes.content: Lots of small bugs fixed. A few items added. Rivers are a thing now.

notes.title: New Tutorial Story!
notes.content:
New tutorial story, [i]A Farmers Plot[/i], has been added.
Mineral deposits are now more random.
Movement bug fixed.
Well item improved.

notes.title: More Stuff Fixed And Improved!
notes.content:
Another loading bug found and squashed!
Cave spawning improved (more to be done).
Starting group character class items bug fixed.
Rest action in away area bug fixed.
Player groups on map now rest when exhausted.

notes.title: Stuff fixed!
notes.content: A few bugs fixed and some new bugs added (centipedes). Also added an earth elemental and werewolf condition.
